message.content:
The Large Magellanic Cloud is about \(1.6 \times 10^5\) light-years away.

For \(v = 0.99999987c\),

\[
\gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}} \approx 1960
\]

The Earth-frame travel time is roughly \(160{,}000\) years, but the astronaut experiences time dilated by \(\gamma\):

\[
t_{\text{astronaut}} \approx \frac{160{,}000}{1960} \approx 81.6 \text{ years}
\]

The astronaut would be about \(22 + 82 = 104\) years old on arrival, still below the average lifetime of 150 years.

Answer: B
